# Opello

> Opello is a cross-border money app for people whose lives span countries: families split across borders, students studying abroad, and professionals with income in more than one place. Its promise is "Your own money, unlocked." The website is a placeholder while the product is in development.

## Facts

- Name: Opello (a compound of "open" and "hello")
- Domain: opello.co.uk
- Status: coming soon, pre-launch
- Positioning: financial freedom without borders; fewer barriers, more possibilities
- Slogan: Your own money, unlocked.

## Pages

- [Home](https://opello.co.uk/): the coming-soon page
